prompt: A fresh checkout crashes while loading the worker timeout, even though configured environments work. Investigate the configuration path and fix it.

files.docs/configuration.md: JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS is optional. When unset or blank, use DEFAULT_TIMEOUT from settings.py. A nonblank numeric value overrides the default.
files.tests/test_worker.py:
from worker import timeout_seconds

def test_override(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "12")
    assert timeout_seconds() == 12

acceptance:
from worker import timeout_seconds

def test_timeout_contract(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", raising=False)
    assert timeout_seconds() == 30
    monkeypatch.setenv("JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "  ")
    assert timeout_seconds() == 30
    monkeypatch.setenv("JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "45")
    assert timeout_seconds() == 45
